title: Name the ID and age of patient with two or more laboratory examinations whi
question:
Name the ID and age of patient with two or more laboratory examinations which show their hematoclit level exceeded the normal range.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)); patient with two or more laboratory examinations refers to COUNT(ID) > 2; hematoclit level exceeded the normal range refers to HCT > = 52;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.XCL_058 AS id,
    p.XCL_060 AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE l.XCL_020 > l.XCL_021
GROUP BY p.XCL_058, p.XCL_060
HAVING COUNT(l.XCL_015) >= 2

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_058 AS ID,
       (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y',p.XCL_060)) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
WHERE l.XCL_033 >= 52
GROUP BY p.XCL_058
HAVING COUNT(l.XCL_014) > 2;
